sources.title: Every Qwen AI Model Explained and Compared (Aug, 2026)
sources.snippet: Qwen is the most downloaded open model family in the world, and its open weights let a team run a near-frontier model with zero per-token cost and full data control. But self-hosting needs real engineers. This guide helps your team pick between open weights and the API, the same way we match engineers to roles.
